rca_of_issue: BUG RCA (CLOSE/CANCEL navigates on web): Card container is TouchableOpacity from react-native-gesture-handler (CardTouchable, asi-bot.tsx:894 / trades-position.tsx:200) whose web implementation subscribes to raw DOM pointer events; inner action buttons use RN-core TouchableOpacity (asi-bot.tsx:1115, trades-position.tsx:359) which uses the RN-web responder system. The two systems do not negotiate on web, so a tap on the button dispatches to BOTH: button onPress opens the confirm dialog (observed: 'Cancel this pending LIMIT order?') and card onPress executes router.push('/asset/crypto/{SYM}') — user is navigated away regardless of confirm outcome. Reproduction (web preview, mobile viewport): seed device localStorage, stub window.confirm=()=>false, mouse-click exact center of CANCEL on a pending card -> URL becomes /asset/crypto/FIL; same for CLOSE on /asi-bot -> /asset/crypto/LINK. Mitigation until fix: none on web; native likely unaffected. Fix: use RNGH TouchableOpacity for inner buttons too (single gesture system negotiates deepest-wins) or stop propagation on the button wrapper (onStartShouldSetResponder -> true / onTouchEnd stopPropagation).
